bg_quit_confirm_body: {n} scheduled posts are due in the next 2 hours and won't publish while MetaDash is closed. Posts scheduled on Facebook itself are not affected.
bg_tray_hint_body: It stays in the tray so scheduled posts can be published. Use Quit in the tray menu to close it completely.
bg_tray_hint_body_mac: It stays in the menu bar so scheduled posts can be published. Use Quit in the menu bar icon to close it completely.
bg_login_item_failed: Could not change the launch-at-login setting: {detail}
approval_code_invalid: This is not a valid MetaDash response code. Paste the whole code starting with MDAP1.
approval_code_mismatch: The response code does not match its approval pack (it may be damaged or edited).
approval_pack_unknown: This response belongs to an approval pack that is not in this database.
approval_no_posts: No posts to include in the approval pack.
approval_too_many: An approval pack can hold at most {max} posts. Narrow the selection.
